headline: Mild days and foggy mornings to Thursday, then wind and light rain Friday, cooler weekend.
summary: Mild, mostly dry weather holds through Thursday. Each morning brings low clouds and patchy fog, densest in the north and south interior and around the Olympics, and it usually clears to sunny afternoons. Highs reach the low 70s by Thursday, with lows in the upper 40s to low 50s. A weak system arrives Friday with gusty winds ahead of it, then light rain into Saturday, with only a tenth to a quarter inch expected. Colder air follows over the weekend and early next week, bringing light snow on mountains above about 4,500 feet and possible frost in outlying areas, though forecasters have low confidence in the frost. Strong winds and rough seas are likely on the coast and Strait Friday.
changes: Frost was added to the outlook after the morning discussion, and forecasters began weighing a fog advisory for tonight into Wednesday morning. Thursday morning fog was also described as much less likely by the afternoon update.
